entities.name: Stanislav Hočevar
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Stanislav Hočevar is a Slovenian Roman Catholic prelate. He was the archbishop of the Archdiocese of Belgrade in Serbia between 2001 and 2022. He was also the president of the International Bishops' Conference of Saints Cyril and Methodius between 2001 and 2011.
